output.rationale: The requirement specifies metal-clad switchgear with compliance to ANSI C37.20 standards. Among the candidates, 'CROWN-ARMV' is an engineered-to-order (ETO) product that provides arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear, which aligns with the technical specification provided in the requirement. Other candidates either do not meet the specific technical criteria or are accessories rather than the main product.
